### The Light of the World
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-may-24-2023.html
Passage: Matthew 5:14-15
Points:
- Jesus gives his followers the same title he claimed for himself: the light of the world.
- The fundamental purpose of light is to dispel darkness, which it does simply by being turned on.
- Light works silently and draws attention naturally without requiring noise, slogans, or showmanship.
- Christ places believers in secular workplaces, schools, and neighborhoods to serve as visible beacons.
- Faithful conduct speaks a powerful, directional message even before words are spoken.

### Living Out Faith in the Real World
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Homeword
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/living-out-faith-in-the-real-world-homeword-october-13.html
Passage: Matthew 5:16
Points:
- Christian faith is not meant to be kept safe within the isolated walls of church culture.
- Faith grows stronger when believers engage real-world challenges where their faith is at risk.
- Jesus set the example by spending time with people outside religious comfort zones.
- Shining one's light means actively befriending, loving, and serving neighbors and colleagues in daily life.
